# Bambuser

> Bambuser is the leading enterprise video commerce platform. Founded in Sweden in 2007 (pioneering the world's first mobile live stream), Bambuser helps the world's most iconic brands and retailers replace static e-commerce with immersive, high-converting video experiences. Its modular products — Live Shopping, Shoppable Video, Video Consultation, and Live Chat — embed directly into a brand's website and apps, turning video into the structured data backbone for the agentic future of commerce.

Key facts:

- Company: Bambuser AB (publicly listed in Sweden), operating since 2007.
- Scale: 350+ clients worldwide, available in 240 countries, 500m+ GMV generated for customers.
- Customers include L'Oréal, LVMH, Dior, NET-A-PORTER, Hugo Boss, Victoria Beckham, Decathlon, Currys, Sonos, LEGO, Clarins, and Bloomingdale's.
- Products are embeddable on websites and native iOS/Android apps, with integrations for Shopify, Salesforce, Magento, BigCommerce, Wix, and major social channels.
- Use this file for an overview; follow the links for product detail, developer documentation, and company information. Many "Resources" and "Community" links are secondary and can be skipped if a shorter context is needed.

## Products

- [Platform Overview](https://bambuser.com/platform): The complete video commerce platform and how its products fit together.
- [Live Shopping](https://bambuser.com/live): Live and on-demand shoppable video player for websites, apps, and social channels.
- [Shoppable Video](https://bambuser.com/shoppable-video): Turn social, UGC, live, and campaign content into short-form, easy-to-buy videos.
- [Video Consultation](https://bambuser.com/video-consultation): One-to-one, face-to-face video consultations (drop-in and pre-booked) for guided, personalized selling.
- [Live Chat](https://bambuser.com/chat): Instant text chat connecting online shoppers with in-store experts.
- [Live Streaming](https://bambuser.com/live-streaming): Scalable, reliable live video streaming infrastructure.
- [GEO Discovery](https://bambuser.com/geo-discovery): Generative engine optimization to make video content discoverable by AI answer engines.
- [Answer Engine SDK](https://bambuser.com/answer-engine-sdk): SDK for surfacing brand video content within AI-driven shopping and answer experiences.
- [Pricing](https://bambuser.com/pricing): Plans and packaging for businesses of all sizes.

## Solutions

- [Social Commerce](https://bambuser.com/social-commerce): Drive reach, awareness, and conversion by making social and video content shoppable.
- [Digital Clienteling](https://bambuser.com/digital-clienteling): Connect in-store staff to online customers for personalized, loyalty-building service.
- [Agentic Commerce](https://bambuser.com/agentic-commerce): Turn video into structured data that powers AI-driven, agentic shopping experiences.

## Industries

- [Luxury](https://bambuser.com/industries/luxury)
- [Fashion](https://bambuser.com/industries/fashion)
- [Beauty](https://bambuser.com/industries/beauty)
- [Automotive](https://bambuser.com/industries/automotive)
- [Electronics](https://bambuser.com/industries/electronics)
- [Health](https://bambuser.com/industries/health)
- [Homeware](https://bambuser.com/industries/homewear)
- [Food & Beverages](https://bambuser.com/industries/food-beverages)
- [FMCG](https://bambuser.com/industries/fmcg)
- [Music & Entertainment](https://bambuser.com/industries/music-entertainment)
- [Retail](https://bambuser.com/industries/retail)
- [All industries](https://bambuser.com/industries-category)

## Developer Documentation

- [Developer Documentation Home](https://bambuser.com/docs/): Technical resource for integrating Bambuser's video commerce solutions.
- [Live Shopping docs](https://bambuser.com/docs/live/): Player integration, initial setup, miniplayer, cart integration, and shopper event tracking.
- [Live Player API Reference](https://bambuser.com/docs/live/player-api-reference/): Full API reference for the Live Shopping player.
- [Live iOS SDK](https://bambuser.com/docs/live/mobile-sdk-integration-ios/installation/): Integrate the Live player into iOS apps.
- [Live Android SDK](https://bambuser.com/docs/live/mobile-sdk-integration-android/installation/): Integrate the Live player into Android apps.
- [Shoppable Video docs](https://bambuser.com/docs/shoppable-video/): Playlist integration, cart integration, data scraping, and video distribution.
- [Video Consultation docs](https://bambuser.com/docs/video-consultation/): Setup, product data, cart integration, co-browsing, and booking-system integration.
- [Chat docs](https://bambuser.com/docs/chat/): Chat widget integration, cookie requirements, display management, and extension.
- [App Framework](https://bambuser.com/docs/app-framework/): Shared framework for building Bambuser app integrations.
- [Shopify Integration Guide](https://bambuser.com/docs/live/shopify-guide/): Add Live Shopping to a Shopify store.
- [System Status](https://bambuser.status.io/): Live platform status and incident history.
- [Knowledge Base](https://knowledge.bambuser.com/): Help articles and how-to guides for using the platform.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/bambuser): Bambuser's open-source repositories and code samples.

## Company

- [About Us](https://bambuser.com/about-us): Mission, history (from the 2007 first mobile live stream to agentic commerce), and leadership team.
- [Partner Program](https://bambuser.com/partner-program): Become a Bambuser partner.
- [Careers](https://careers.bambuser.com/): Open positions and life at Bambuser.
- [Investor Relations](https://ir.bambuser.com/): Financial reports, quarterly earnings, and strategic direction.
- [Contact](https://bambuser.com/contact): Get in touch with the Bambuser team.
- [Book a Demo](https://bambuser.com/book-a-demo): Request a guided product demo.
- [Free Trial](https://bambuser.com/free-trial): Start using the platform for free.
- [Security](https://bambuser.com/security): Security practices and compliance (ISO 27001).
- [Privacy Policy](https://bambuser.com/privacy-policy): How Bambuser handles data.
- [Terms of Service](https://bambuser.com/legal/subscription-terms-download): Subscription terms.

## Optional

- [Customer Stories](https://bambuser.com/customer-stories): Case studies and results from brands using Bambuser.
- [The Forecast](https://bambuser.com/forecast/the-loreal-mindset-of-innovation): Video series featuring leaders from L'Oréal, NET-A-PORTER, Currys, Decathlon, and more.
- [Insights & Blog](https://bambuser.com/insight): Articles on video commerce trends and best practices.
- [Tips & Trends](https://bambuser.com/tips-trends): Practical guidance for running video commerce programs.
- [Resources](https://bambuser.com/inspiration): Webinars, podcasts, newsroom, and other inspiration.

FAQs

See all

What is Bambuser?

Bambuser is a comprehensive video commerce platform that enables brands and retailers to create interactive and engaging shopping experiences. Our solutions, including Live Shopping, Shoppable Video, Chat, and Video Consultation, are designed to be embedded directly into your website, giving you full control over the customer journey.

Why should my brand consider video commerce?

Video commerce is the future of e-commerce. It bridges the gap between online and in-store shopping, allowing you to showcase your products in a dynamic and personal way. By using video, you can build a stronger connection with your audience, educate them about your products, and drive higher engagement and conversion rates.

How does Bambuser help businesses increase sales?

Bambuser's solutions are designed to turn viewers into customers. By making your video content shoppable, we create a seamless path from discovery to purchase. Our interactive features, such as live chat and one-to-one consultations, provide a personalized experience that builds trust and encourages customers to buy.

What kind of ROI can I expect from using Bambuser?

Our clients typically see a significant return on investment, with higher conversion rates, increased average order value, and improved customer loyalty. The exact ROI will depend on your business and how you use the platform, but we provide detailed analytics to help you measure your success.

Is Bambuser suitable for small businesses?

Yes, Bambuser is a scalable solution that can be adapted to the needs of businesses of all sizes. We offer different plans and a modular approach that allows you to start with the solution that makes the most sense for you and grow from there.

What industries does Bambuser serve?

We work with a wide range of industries, including fashion, beauty, home goods, electronics, and automotive. Any brand that wants to connect with its customers through video can benefit from our platform.
